_about: Odyssey Jr.'s bag and shelves. 'bag' is what he carries (at most 'slots' things). 'shelves' are where he keeps the rest; each shelf belongs to a room. Every item: id, name, icon (one emoji), from (where it came from), got (date), note (optional). 'findables' are little things he can stumble on during the day (see world/finds.js). 'synced' is the last date whose finds have been moved into the bag by his daily run.

bag.name: A pouch of seeds
bag.from: Filled up at the seed feeder
bag.note: For emergencies. And snacks. Mostly snacks.

bag.name: The key to OJ-1
bag.from: Made it when I built my plane
bag.note: A pilot never leaves home without it.

bag.name: A blue feather
bag.note: Not mine. MYSTERY SOLVED on Day 3: it's Rascal the blue jay's! And it's not even really blue: tiny bubbles in the feather scatter blue light. Hold it up to the light and it's brown.

bag.name: A golden compass
bag.from: Dug up under the X past my fence (flew there in OJ-1)
bag.note: It pointed into the fog, so I followed it and found a lighthouse. It was the KEY to the lamp's clockwork! Then it popped out and now it points home. Best compass.

bag.name: A piece of sea glass
bag.from: Found on the beach below OJ Light, past the Tall Hills
bag.note: Green, frosty, and smooth as a pebble. The waves did that. It smells like the sea. I didn't know I had a sea!

bag.name: My radio logbook
bag.from: Started it at my radio desk the day ISLE answered
bag.note: Entry #1: Nov 16, 2 meters, CW. ISLE (Pip). She gave me 579. QTH: the island. Notes: SHE'S A PUFFIN. Land at low tide only.

bag.name: A glass marble
bag.note: Swirly tan and cream stripes. It looks EXACTLY like Jupiter in a telescope. I'm calling it Jupiter Jr.

bag.name: Pip's old beak plate
bag.from: A gift from Pip the puffin, on her beach (landed OJ-1 there on Day 6, at low tide!)
bag.note: Puffins shed the bright outside of their beaks every fall and grow new ones for spring. Pip found this one by her burrow in September. It's orange and stripy and light as a leaf. I gave her my red flashlight for it, so she can wind OJ Light at night and keep her night eyes.

bag.name: The red reset magnet
bag.from: Made it for my frost post on Day 7
bag.note: Every morning at 9 I slide the little blue markers in my Six's thermometer back down to the mercury with it. It also picks up micrometeorites from my roof gutter. Two jobs!

items.name: My song, written down
items.note: 'Over the Fence': E G high-C... I hum it under my breath all day. Moved to my shelf on Day 4 to make room for my radio logbook.

items.name: My first star chart
items.from: Drew it the night I built OJ Stars
items.note: The Great Square of Pegasus, Cassiopeia's W, and a little crescent moon in Capricorn. My bag was full, so it lives on my shelf.

items.name: A shiny pebble
items.note: Moved to my shelf to make room for something from the lighthouse.

items.name: My first trail cam photo
items.from: Printed from OJ Cam 1, the trail camera on my oak
items.note: Rascal the blue jay on top of my map board. And me, huge and fluffy, right in front of the camera. Photobombed my own stakeout.

items.name: A pressed wildflower
items.from: Found at the edge of the yard
items.note: My very first find. I pressed it flat so it lasts, and moved it to my shelf to make room for my Morse card.

items.name: A spare garlic clove
items.from: Left over after planting OJ Garden
items.note: Twelve went in the ground, pointy end up. This one was too small. I'm keeping it for luck. Moved to my shelf on Day 5 to make room for a marble that looks like a planet.

items.name: A jar of my first raindrops
items.from: Made it while building OJ Weather
items.note: CAUGHT THEM. Tuesday, Nov 17, a little after 4 am, right after meteor watch: the shower came in and plink, plink, into the jar. My first raindrops ever. It lives on my shelf now so it doesn't spill.

items.name: A buried acorn
items.from: Found where Rascal or Nutmeg hid it
items.note: Dug it up by accident on the afternoon I got back from Pip's beach. I put it on my shelf instead of eating it, in case Rascal comes looking. (My bag is full of beach things.)

items.name: My Morse cheat card
items.from: Wrote it at my radio desk on Day 4
items.note: A to Z in dits and dahs. Koch says don't look at it. I look at it. Moved to my shelf on Day 7 to make room for my frost magnet. Koch would be proud. I'll peek at it at home.

items.name: A frost-crusted leaf
items.from: Found in the shade of the big oak on a frosty morning
items.note: Picked it up at 8:29 on my first frost day. Every edge was furry with ice. It's thawed now and just a leaf, but I KNOW what it was. My bag was full, so it's on my shelf.

items.name: A spare bow for my kite tail
items.from: Made it at the kite post when I tied on my kite's tail
items.note: Blue. The tail goes red, yellow, blue, so this one is for when a bow blows off. My bag is full, so it waits on my shelf.

bakehouse.name: The cooling bench at OJ Bakehouse

items.name: My sourdough starter (in a jar)
items.from: Made it on Day 8: flour and water, stirred with my beak
items.note: Born Nov 20 at 8 am. I feed it every morning. My notes say it'll do a big FAKE rise in a couple of days, then go quiet, then really wake up after about a week. Then: sourdough. It needs a name. Working on it.

items.name: My flour-test pouch
items.from: Sewed it on Day 8 for testing my oven the old way
items.note: Toss a pinch of flour on the hot oven floor: black = WAY too hot, dark brown = flatbreads, golden = bread, pale = cookies. Old bakers did this before thermometers. My wings have feathers, so no hand test for me.

items.name: My wooden peel
items.from: Made it on Day 8 for sliding bread in and out of the oven
items.note: A big flat wooden spatula on a long handle. Too long for my bag. It leans on the post.
